notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TkQEfiSkuJc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! 
We've just released a new update for Status One. While it's not a major update, it includes some interesting changes and improvements — including three new level-one maps to make the beginning of the gameplay more varied. More details in the video.

Patch Notes – Version 1.2.0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/5e3c009b7682c05a82d254febb1a83d1d0ba671c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/e2e27a0f68e464aeb78c21f434e8b9bf3d78fa18.png[/img]


[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New home UI that shows current storyline
[*] Added 3 new maps.
[*] Introduced Auto-Ream system.
[*] Win chance percentage now visible during simulation.
[*] Enemies now try to run away from grenades.
[*] New tutorial accessible from the main menu.
[*] New achievement for completing all Quick Missions.
[*] New surrender system for civilians.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Renamed "Custom Missions" to "Quick Game".
[*] Wounded operators in barracks no longer gain experience.
[*] Reduced game size from 20 GB to 7 GB.
[*] Changed the behavior of the combat simulation system.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug with danger points.
[*] Fixed bug with character outlines.
[*] Fixed bug where dying units received experience.
[*] Fixed incorrect repair prices.
[*] Fixed bug where achievements could be earned in custom missions.
[*] Fixed issue where allies could kill the player.
[*] Improved font formatting for Russian language in character creation menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_nZAnCzP9h8;full][/previewyoutube]


[b][h2]Added[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] New gamemode, custom mission where you can play every mission regardless of campaign, with different difficulty settings and a rating system for all of them.
[*] Danger point system where you can point out dangerous spots for your operators to check.
[*] 4 new weapons.
[*] New armor.
[*] Enemy engage voicelines.
[*] Visual lock icon in the preparation section showing the required renown level for each operator slot unlock.
[*] Shop buying sound.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/05ac374aa2f754204dbf2064a3d7dc3011319777.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/9efd9ed663a9fc20e82e4291702bf86def768b83.png[/img]

[b][h2]Changed[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Now you can give orders with the left mouse button also.
[*] RTS selection now requires the left Shift to be pressed.
[*] New section in the tutorial explaining new systems.
[*] Main player UI showing the current bound key for every player action.
[*] Reworked "Mercenary" outfit.
[*] N2 Guardian rifle nerfed and moved to Tier I.
[*] Viven nerfed and moved to Tier II.
[/list]

[b][h2]Fixed[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Using a grenade near a door caused a visual bug with the red targeting line.
[*] Missing and misspelled translations.
[*] Spamming the mouse button and Enter key during mission loading caused the mission to be abandoned.
[*] Missing reload key bind in settings.
[*] During an operator arrest task, interrupting him caused the order to be ignored.
[/list]

[b][h2]New Gear[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Reaper 21 (Tier IV): Semi-auto shotgun using slug ammo, adding much flavor to the game. Very high damage and very high accuracy compensate for a very small magazine. This weapon requires precise shots.
[*] Artemis v4 (Tier II): Rifle, a perfect median between N2 Guardian and Falcon 15.
[*] UMBER 45 (Tier II): SMG, a perfect addition to the early-game arsenal.
[*] Stinger 9 (Tier I): SMG added alongside the Sapphire to spice up the early-game shop. Very cheap and useful on your first missions.
[*] Riot Armor (Tier I): Your first hard armor before the plate carrier.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/8649650f9b145824c4d746bf438c2246e36cd3fe.png[/img]

notes.title: Status One Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/a7afec550d088b68ca8be249cb94ce1e14c9d592.png[/img]

[b][h2]We have some exciting news for you! Status One demo will be available on Steam on October 1st, 2024!🎉[/h2] [/b]

[b]But that's not all![/b] 🚀

We're also excited to announce that we'll be participating in the Steam Next Fest! 🎮 This is your chance to play our demo, explore the game, and share your feedback with us. We can't wait for you to experience what we’ve been working on!

It’s a great opportunity to discover what makes Status One special and tell us what you think! 💬

Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to the release date, and be sure to join our community on Discord! Connect with other players, share your thoughts, and get exclusive updates directly from the development team. 🔔

[h2][b][url=https://discord.gg/dgkc2YvCtJ]Join our Discord here![/url][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020139/5be5742ef458497da636de3db820127df9bae92c.png[/img]

[b]See you in the game![/b]

tags.feature: Status One demo will be available on Steam on October 1st, 2024!🎉
